reviews.text: Courtesy and professionalism, excellent service!
Top-notch expertise and professionalism...and above all, a lot of patience.

A golden-haired, stubborn, uncooperative old dog. He hates water, hates being brushed, hates the blast of the hair dryer, and hadn't been to the groomer in a good eight months. In short, mission impossible. And yet. And yet I went to Fabau, and, him and his beautiful daughter, hairless and tired as if after a fight in the ring, they gave him back to me with his fur in order, free of dreadlocks and knots, clean, smooth, and smelling good. His big head is beautiful, and I'm so happy.
What can I say? Trust Fabau, you won't regret it.
My kikko always and only at Fabau ❤️. Seriousness, professionalism, and respect. Thank you so much.
Fabrizio and Emanuela are wonderful, they love animals and are very scrupulous and attentive, our furry children are in good hands with them... 🤗 …
Fabrizio is very kind and knowledgeable. He's always very patient with my hyperactive poodle.
Extremely satisfied with the work done on my poodle, i.e. the first grooming
Very helpful staff, meticulous attention to detail. I'm happy with my choice, and I wouldn't change them. Thank you so much, Fabau.
Excellent value for money, they are really very good and my dog ​​comes out of there super calm and as good as new
Simply brilliant, passionate, very kind, they really put their heart into it!
Professional, competent, and super kind. I brought my poodle to you, perfect cut!! I will never abandon you again... Neve ♥️
An extremely welcoming place, highly qualified staff, furry friends are pampered, more than a grooming shop it's a spa for dogs, highly recommended!

Extremely satisfied, very kind, polite, professional people, and they treat animals with love, sensitivity, and care. My dog ​​leaves feeling calm and serene, unlike other places where he would leave traumatized. I've been coming to them all my life.

I couldn’t be happier with the grooming service! My dog Logan came back looking absolutely adorable, smelling fresh, and feeling so soft. The groomer was kind, patient, and clearly passionate about his work. He took great care of my pet and made the whole experience stress-free. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a skilled and caring groomer!

Excellent, professional. Fair prices!! I really liked them.
They'll be my go-to.

Always kind, helpful, punctual, and above all, COMPETENT.
I've been taking my Samoyed (an uncommon breed that requires a certain amount of patience, care, and expertise) to them for several months now, and every time he comes out absolutely PERFECT: fragrant, soft, pure white, spotless, and knot-free (which, judging by previous experiences at other groomers, is not to be taken for granted).
The price is very fair, and above all, the service is worth every penny.
Plus, the first person to be super happy to return to them is my big puppy (even though he's never been a fan of baths 😂).
I'll never change them again 🥹
Highly recommended!
I've been taking my Luna to Fabau for several years now, they're very kind and very good, and Luna goes there with pleasure :)
Professional, welcoming and loving, our Yuki and we are all 100/100 satisfied

My experience was impeccable because they are people who love animals so our puppies are very happy with them and above all the haircut of Desy, a Toy Poodle, was done with excellent professionalism, thank you so much ❤️
What can I say except that they are exceptional! So much love, patience, and passion for their work, my dogs adore them ♥️TOP♥️

Camilla won't even let me brush her. I take her to Fabau all dirty and disheveled and I take her back clean, fluffy, and smelling great.

We went for the first time today, having previously had bad experiences with others in the industry. We're super happy with the result. My dog ​​has very difficult hair, a long-haired mixed breed, and we're happy to have found two patient and professional people! Highly recommended.
My furry friends come out like stuffed animals. Plus, you'll find professionalism and education.

I brought my poodle Noah four years ago... and it was love at first sight.
Available and professional, attentive and loving, Fabrizio and Manuela are a guarantee.
Welcoming and clean place.
I recommend visually ♥️♥️♥️

I took my little Tommy to this wonderful family. I'm extremely happy with the result: his coat is shiny and super soft.
Tommy is very wary of strangers, but he felt comfortable with them from the very first meeting, and they use excellent quality products. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy groomer; you'll be completely satisfied.

I took my two dogs to Fabau for grooming and was very satisfied. My dogs aren't usually bathers, but with the professionalism and kindness of the Fabau staff, they were able to bathe with ease and left feeling relaxed, clean, and smelling fresh.
I absolutely recommend this center for grooming your four-legged friends.

I've only taken my cocker spaniel to the groomer once, and that evening she couldn't get up from her kennel. So I immediately took her to the vet, who, after several X-rays and tests, told me she had a severe spinal contusion. The dog didn't fall at home, so we assumed she fell in the only place she'd been without me... well, less than one star.
Polite and very knowledgeable staff, fully satisfied with my Poodle
Excellent, there are no words, excellent value for money, very kind and true love for pets
Adorable with puppies, and then it feels like being in a spa for animals, if you want to give your puppy some healthy relaxation, take him to fabau 😘 …
The staff is professional, friendly, and knowledgeable. You can tell they're passionate about their work. Highly recommended!

Exceptional and caring staff, they do this job with love and passion for animals. My little Pocho loves their cuddles!!
Highly recommended!

The staff were friendly and extremely knowledgeable, the place was clean and well-kept. My poodle was treated really well and the cut was done perfectly.
Fantastic!!!! I recommend it.
Kind and very knowledgeable people

The care given to my little Maltese is one of a kind.
I highly recommend entrusting yourself to their care; they're expert and patient with all puppies, no matter their size.
A special shout-out to Manuela, who's incredibly sweet and helpful.
Go there now!!!
